name: Question 1
problem: Jordan did an experiment in his Chemistry class. He heated a liquid whose initial temperature was $-{1.2}^{∘}\,\text{C}.$ After several minutes, the temperature of the liquid increased by ${7.3}^{∘}\,\text{C}$, at which point he decided to end the experiment. What was the final temperature of the liquid?

Question 1

Jordan did an experiment in his Chemistry class. He heated a liquid whose initial temperature was −1.2∘C. After several minutes, the temperature of the liquid increased by 7.3∘C, at which point he decided to end the experiment. What was the final temperature of the liquid?

a
5.1∘C
b
6.1∘C
c
5.5∘C
d
5.7∘C
e
6.5∘C
